title: Risotto Primavera
subtitle: with creamy root vegetable puree
description: A creamy white wine and parmesan risotto with fresh peas, enriched with a silky celeriac and parsley root puree.

steps.text: Make the root puree: bring the roughly chopped celeriac, parsley root and milk to the boil in a small pot. Lower the heat and cook covered for 25 minutes until soft.
Strain and keep the cooking liquid. Blend the roots with a little of the liquid to a smooth, thick puree. Season with salt. Add 2 tbsp butter and blend only until absorbed. Keep warm.
Heat the stock in a pot and keep it hot.

Saute the chopped eschalots in a medium pot with 2 tbsp butter, add the rice and stir for 1 minute. Add the white wine and let it evaporate. Add a ladle of hot stock and stir until absorbed. Continue adding stock like this until the liquid runs out or the risotto is ready (soft with a slight bite).
Stir in the peas and the root puree until thickened. Add the remaining butter and the grated parmesan and stir until absorbed. Season with salt.
Divide between bowls, top with parmesan shavings and pea sprouts and serve.
